title: Cluj Napoca celebrate Cup title
description: Oradea - Cluj Napoca 84-85 Cluj Napoca celebrated Romanian Cup title. They nipped Oradea in the Final tonight. The guests trailed by 4 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 3-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 85-84, following a late free throw from Daron Russell. Cluj Napoca outrebounded Oradea 42-30 including a 17-5 advantage in offensive rebounds. 26 personal fouls committed by Oradea helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international point guard Daron Russell (180-1998, college: Maryland) who helped to win the game recording 21 points and 5 assists. Serbian center Dusan Miletic (213-1998) contributed with 18 points and 9 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field) for the winners.
